messages:
Maya (PM): Heads up — we need a concise SEO + redirects plan for the webinar landing and the benchmark post. Key goals: capture organic traffic for benchmarking queries, preserve existing backlink equity, and make lead routing reliable for GA4 and Pardot.
Sam (SEO): Quick ask: can we get the seed keyword list by EOD? I’ll prioritize target intent and map to content clusters.
Priya (Content): I’ve drafted 6 headlines for the webinar post; will add longtail keyword variants once Sam drops the list.
Jon (Growth): For inbound routing: use utm_medium=webinar, utm_source=org, and a hidden form field source=webinar2026 so Pardot can segment. Also need a fallback when utm params are stripped.
Eve (Analytics): Confirming: GA4 event 'lead_webinar' and a conversion tag in Pardot. I can set up audiences if we standardize the hidden field.
Sam (SEO): Attached priority keywords (top -> low): ["llm inference cost optimization", "low-latency llm serving", "inference batching strategies", "kv cache for transformers", "model rollout canary"] — map these to: webinar landing (1-3), benchmark post (1,3,4), technical appendix (4,5).
Priya (Content): Good. I’ll weave primary keyword 1 into H1 and webinar meta description. Need final H1 options.
Maya (PM): For redirects: we have /blog/old-benchmark -> needs 301 to /benchmarks/2026-inference-latency. Also several event pages from last year to consolidate. Sam, can you propose a redirect matrix?
Sam (SEO): Draft redirect rules (nginx style):
```
# preserve backlinks
rewrite ^/blog/old-benchmark$ /benchmarks/2026-inference-latency permanent;
rewrite ^/events/old-webinar$ /webinars/2026-inference-best-practices permanent;
# temp hold for A/B variants
rewrite ^/promo/webinar-variant-a$ /webinars/2026?variant=a redirect;
```
I’ll export CSV with source,target,status,next_check.
Priya (Content): We should add canonical tags on the benchmark post pointing to the canonical URI /benchmarks/2026-inference-latency to avoid duplication with webinar transcript.
Jon (Growth): On lead routing edge case: if landing page is cached or copied without utm, use server-side detection of referer + hidden field fallback = 'ref-webinar-mailer' when referer matches our campaign domain.
Eve (Analytics): I’ll implement a GA4 custom dimension 'campaign_source' populated from hidden field or utm_source. That will help pivot reports.
Maya (PM): Internal linking — add sitewide link from /product/performance -> benchmarks page, and include a contextual CTA in the runtime docs. That helps PR flow.
Sam (SEO): Also add schema: use Event schema on the webinar landing (JSON-LD) and Article schema for benchmark post. Minimal Event JSON-LD:
```
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Inference Benchmark Webinar","startDate":"2026-04-22T16:00:00Z","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinars/2026-inference-best-practices"}}
```
Priya (Content): I’ll paste that into the header for the landing. Also adding speakernames and aggregateRating (if we collect thumb responses).
Maya (PM): Timeline: Sam — redirect CSV + canonical checklist by tomorrow morning. Priya — finalize H1s and meta desc. Jon — confirm hidden-field fallback on server. Eve — GA4 dim and conversion. I’ll run the deployment window with eng on Friday.
Sam (SEO): Noted, will include redirect audit (broken links, inbound referrs) and a tag for any 301 chains >2.
Jon (Growth): Small ask — can we append `?source=webinar-email` to confirmation CTA for Pardot sync? Should be fine.
Eve (Analytics): Done — I’ll surface a dashboard with sessions by source, conversions, and lead quality.
deploy-bot: Reminder: redirect-sweep job scheduled for 2026-04-23 02:00 UTC — will validate 200/301/404 and post report in #eng-sre.
Priya (Content): One more: internal linking microcopy — use "See our inference benchmarks" as anchor text. Sam ok with that?
Sam (SEO): Yes, anchor looks good for intent. Add LSI terms in the first paragraph.
Maya (PM): Great. Followups: Sam upload CSV to /docs/seo/redirects/webinar-2026.csv, Priya save final assets to /marketing/webinars/2026/landing, and @Jon deploy the hidden-field patch to staging for QA. Meeting end. :white_check_mark:
